description: Please join us at the home ofMike Knapp & Rachel Morse for a FUNdraiser on Friday, October 4th from 5:30-7:30pm to elect Donna Mears for State House! Come to support Donna and stay for Harry Crawford’s famous Louisiana Cuisine and lively conversation. See you there!
paid_for_by: Paid for by Donna Mears for Alaska
title: Donna Mears FUNdraiser – Donna Mears for State House
